# harness_chaos_scan (Data Source)

Data source for reading a Harness Chaos scan and the risks it produced.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "harness_chaos_scan" "example" {
  org_id     = "default"
  project_id = "demo"
  identity   = "cart_deploy_scan"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `identity` (String) Identifier of the scan to read.
- `org_id` (String) Organization identifier of the project that owns the scan.
- `project_id` (String) Project identifier of the scan.

### Read-Only

- `account_id` (String) Account identifier.
- `collected_data` (List of Object) Resources collected before analysis.
- `completed_at` (Number) Completion time as a Unix timestamp.
- `created_at` (Number) Creation time as a Unix timestamp.
- `created_by` (String) User who created the scan.
- `description` (String) Description of the scan.
- `detection_method` (String) Detection method used by the scan.
- `error_message` (String) Error recorded when the scan fails.
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `infrastructure_scan` (List of Object) Infrastructure scan recorded on the scan.
- `name` (String) Name of the scan.
- `pipeline_scan` (List of Object) Pipeline scan recorded on the scan.
- `result` (String) Outcome of a completed scan.
- `retry_count` (Number) Number of times the scan has been retried.
- `risk_summary` (List of Object) Analysis summary written when the scan finishes.
- `risks` (List of Object) Risks produced by this scan.
- `scan_type` (String) Scan type recorded by the API.
- `status` (String) Scan lifecycle status.
- `summary` (List of Object) Severity rollup for the scan.
- `tags` (List of String) Tags associated with the scan.
- `updated_at` (Number) Last update time as a Unix timestamp.
- `updated_by` (String) User who last updated the scan.

Nested attributes match the [`harness_chaos_scan`](../resources/chaos_scan) resource.
